description: Copy to labels/fitness-goals.json and edit. Fitness goals shown on the Overview tab. per:'week' sums the metric over Mon-Sun calendar weeks; per:'day' scores each day on its own. Metrics: z2 / z4 = minutes at >=65% / >=85% of personal HRmax during explicit workouts (Apple Health + Peloton, deduped); exercise_min = Apple exercise-ring minutes; steps = daily steps; active_energy = active kcal burned (move ring); stand_hours = distinct hours with stand time (stand ring); stand_min = stand minutes; asleep_min = effective sleep per night; deep_min = deep-sleep minutes per night; sessions / session_min = merged explicit workouts. short (optional) sets the row label in the Targets strip. color (optional) overrides the chart color with any CSS color. shape:'violin' (weekly goals only) draws each week as a vertical violin whose axis is the days of the week: each day stacks a slice as tall as its minutes (top tip = weekly sum) and as wide as its minutes.
